node.statement: Diagonal Ha lower-modulus propagation: there are universal C_diag < infinity and e_diag > 0 such that, for every H-CB datum with e <= e_diag, if the level-one lower modulus of Ha^Q_{P,P} is at least 1/4, then ||(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(Z)|| >= (1-C_diag*e)||Z|| for every n >= 1 and Z in M_n tensor S_P.
